acceptance: Test frontmatter, tabs, admonitions, includes, headings, Unicode, malformed fences, missing includes and include cycles.
card.contract: Test frontmatter, tabs, admonitions, includes, headings, Unicode, malformed fences, missing includes and include cycles.
exclusions: No unit tests. No weakening acceptance criteria. No personal Pi sessions, paid inference, publication or host execution of agent tools.
Tests and small fixtures may be added; broader production changes require NEEDS_REPLAN.
card.goal: Extract Markdown preserving headings, tabs, includes and fenced code

acceptance.holdout_policy: sealed before training; retire if any final failure informs a change

execution_policy.export: BF16 fused HF -> pinned llama.cpp F16 GGUF -> Q4_K_M -> new Ollama name; same baseline route; no built-in MLX Qwen3 GGUF export

full.episode_tiebreak: shortest student rendering then seed order
full.reviews: every promoted record; independent amendments/disagreements plus stratified 10% of remaining; no unresolved facts; all 8 train and valid buckets nonempty

pi.tools: container-backed read/bash/edit/write; nonroot, network-none, no host home/credentials/docker.sock/hidden tests

execution_policy.source_policy: All four official domains; retain content-category licensing provenance and stable version evidence. Melange may proceed on the user confirmation recorded in artifacts/decisions/melange-user-confirmation-20261016.json; do not label it an upstream license verification or infer an SPDX license. Group duplicates/translations/task families before split.
execution_policy.tests: E2E only: public CLI/Pi subprocesses; real persistence and tools. Scripted external inference fixtures allowed only in deterministic tier. No unit tests or internal mocks.

training.checkpoint: final only; restart unless full optimizer/RNG/sampler state is verified
training.loss: only next approved assistant content/tool call plus EOS; explicit mask; no padding or prior actions
training.sampling: equal domain/stream draws; then uniform episode and approved target

workflow: Run current E2E; edit only allowed files; run affected E2Es; inspect artifacts; record evidence. Maximum 3 failed repairs. No weakened tests, limits, stubs, or unapproved stage advances.
